definitions.explanation: Strong and barely controllable emotion; intense enthusiasm or dedication to something.

examples.japanese: {情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧。
{情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いでいる→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧。
examples.english: He pours his passion into music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：noentry⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't forget the passion of your youth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対：03382_tai⟧{情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{続|つづ}け→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧、30⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{教壇|きょうだん}→教壇：17174_kyoudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ってきた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: She has maintained her passion for education and has stood at the podium for 30 years.

notes:
{情熱|じょうねつ} refers to intense passion or fervor directed toward something. Composed of {情|じょう} (emotion) + {熱|ねつ} (heat). Stronger and more emotional than ⟦{熱意|ねつい}→熱意：05088_netsui⟧ (enthusiasm).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour one's passion into
- {情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have passion
- {情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧: to burn with passion
- {情熱|じょうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧: to devote one's passion to

DERIVED FORM:
{情熱的|じょうねつてき}（な）: passionate (na-adjective). {情熱的|じょうねつてき}な{演奏|えんそう} (a passionate performance).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {熱意|ねつい}: enthusiasm, zeal (more controlled, less emotional)
- {熱情|ねつじょう}: passionate emotion (literary)
- {熱中|ねっちゅう}: being absorbed in something
- {意欲|いよく}: motivation, eagerness (more practical)
